Subject: Permission for Foreign Visit in the cadre of Social Security Assistants and
other Group 'C' Cadres - regarding.

Reference: -

(i) DOPT O.M. No. 11013/8/ 2015-Estt.A-Ill dated 27.07.2015

(ii) Head Office Circular No. HRM-III/23(11)14/TN&KR/EO-AO/Foreign Visit/Passport
Dated:21.08.2015

(iii) Head Office Circular No. HRD/2(1)2013/Delegation of Powers/2092 dated: 02.05.2016

(iv) Head Office Circular No. HRD/2(1)2013/Delegation of Power/14453 dated 06.10.2017

Madam) Sir,
Please refer to circular cited above subject.

2. In this regard, the following instructions are issued in order to ensure the timely
processing of such proposals:

(i) The source of expenses to be examined at Regional Office and Zonal Office level
and forwarded with clear certificate that “source of finance declared have been
examined and no discrepancies/irregularities were found”.

(ii) Any discrepancies/irregularities noticed in the sources of funds or the Bank statement
of the employee, should be duly examined and clarified before forwarding requests
for the approval of the Competent Authority.

(iii) The details of past foreign visits with source of funding mentioned may also be
forwarded in tabular form as per format.

3. The request may be as forwarded at least 21 days in advance to the proposed date
of journey to avoid last minute delay Zonal Office to forward with clear recommendation for
approval of the request duly certifying that all details have been confirmed and found
satisfactory.

4. As the Disciplinary Authority, prescribed under the Employees’ Provident Fund (Staff
and Conditions of Service) Regulations, 2025, has been revised, the Vigilance Clearance
Certificate may be issued by the Competent Authority in accordance with the said
Regulations.

(This issues with the approval of the Competent Authority)

Yours faithfully...

@

(Aditya Sah)
